summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of redesigned A11y assistant components and public page action buttons. All features working correctly with professional, elegant design while preserving theme colors (teal #117A69, navy #232F3E, mint #6FE3CF, amber).
passed_tests: Landing page (/) loads without errors - hero, 4 data cards, SpeakMini pill buttons with aria-pressed
A11y assistant button (a11y-assistant-btn) opens/closes panel, Alt+A keyboard shortcut works
A11y panel has all 3 tabs (Tampilan, Tunanetra, Tunarungu) with proper aria-selected switching
Tampilan tab: text size buttons (normal/large/xlarge), contrast toggle, motion toggle, speech rate (normal/slow/slower), try voice button, reset button - all with proper aria attributes
Tunanetra tab: read page button, stop button, status indicator, section list (4 items) with jump/read buttons (a11y-jump-N, a11y-read-N), focus read toggle, voice command toggle
Tunarungu tab: captions toggle (aria-checked), easy mode toggle, BISINDO toggle (disabled when no video), transcript button, try caption button
Help dialog: opens via a11y-open-help button or '?' key, has a11y-help-close (X button), NEW a11y-help-done button, a11y-help-speak button, closes via Esc key
Public dashboard (/publik): privacy badge, SpeakMini pill intro button ('Dengarkan pengantar'), 4 category cards with SpeakMini buttons
Chart accessibility blocks: all 4 charts (kecamatan, kemiskinan, stunting, ats) have NEW chart-*-a11y-block testid, ringkasan text, toggle button (aria-expanded), speak button
Chart table toggle: expands/collapses data table with proper aria-expanded state
Public header: logo link, nav links (pubnav-home, pubnav--publik, pubnav--publik-peta-sosial, pubnav--publik-peta-kemiskinan, pubnav--tentang), login button, active state styling

Map page (/publik/peta-sosial): skip-map link, 3 category tabs (disabilitas/stunting/ats), level buttons (kecamatan/kelurahan with aria-pressed), filter dropdown, search input/button, reset button, marker toggle (checked state)
Map ranking list and data table: ranking list visible, a11y-map-table with 15 a11y-map-row rows (accessibility alternative)
Tentang page (/tentang): tentang-daftar-ngo button links to /login?mode=ngo
Mobile viewport (390px): public-menu-toggle visible and functional, A11y button visible and panel opens correctly
Theme colors preserved: teal rgb(11,79,69), navy rgb(35,47,62), no overlapping elements
NEW features confirmed: SpeakMini variant='pill' with aria-pressed, a11y-help-done button, a11y-transcript-close testid, chart-*-a11y-block testids
